content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a highly scalable object storage platform that allows you to store and serve large amounts of data, such as digital products. It's designed to be a drop-in replacement for traditional storage solutions, like Amazon S3, but with the added benefit of being a part of the Cloudflare network. This means that your data is stored in a secure, distributed environment that's optimized for performance and scalability. By using R2, you can say goodbye to expensive storage costs and hello to faster, more reliable delivery of your digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

R2 uses a combination of object storage and CDNs (content delivery networks) to ensure that your digital products are delivered quickly and efficiently to your customers. When a customer requests a file, R2 checks to see if it's already cached in the nearest CDN location. If it is, the file is served directly from the cache, reducing the latency and improving the overall user experience. If the file isn't cached, R2 retrieves it from the underlying storage layer and serves it from the CDN, ensuring that your customers receive the best possible experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

R2 is designed specifically for digital creators who want to sell their products online without relying on traditional payment systems. Whether you're an ebook author, a course creator, or a software developer, R2 gives you the flexibility to deliver your products directly to your customers, without the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. With R2, you can focus on creating and selling your products, while R2 takes care of the storage and delivery infrastructure.
With R2, you can say goodbye to expensive storage costs and hello to faster, more reliable delivery of your digital products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

R2 is built on top of Cloudflare's robust infrastructure, which includes a global network of data centers and CDNs. This allows R2 to provide fast and reliable delivery of digital products to customers all over the world. Additionally, R2 integrates seamlessly with other Cloudflare products, such as Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, to provide a comprehensive solution for digital creators. By using R2, you can build a scalable and secure infrastructure that meets the needs of your growing business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with R2, you'll need to create an account on the Cloudflare dashboard and set up a new bucket for your digital products. From there, you can upload your files and configure the storage and delivery settings to meet your specific needs. Once you've got R2 up and running, you can integrate it with your existing infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, making it easy to deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question you're probably asking is: 'How much will I save by using R2 instead of Stripe or PayPal?' The answer is: a lot. With R2, you'll save on storage costs and eliminate the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal, which can charge up to 10% commission on each sale. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921. That's a significant amount of money that you can keep in your pocket, rather than sending to middlemen like Stripe or PayPal.
R2 is a drop-in replacement for traditional storage solutions, making it easy to integrate with your existing infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for more ways to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment systems, be sure to check out the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates for a comprehensive solution. You can also visit the Shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about how to deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital commerce stack using R2 and NOWPayments, follow these steps: Create an account on the Cloudflare dashboard and set up a new bucket for your digital products. Upload your files and configure the storage and delivery settings to meet your specific needs. Integrate R2 with your existing infrastructure using Cloudflare Workers. Set up NOWPayments to process payments directly from the R2 bucket. Configure the payment settings to meet your specific needs. Test the entire system to ensure that it's working correctly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sign up for Cloudflare R2?

To sign up for R2, simply create an account on the Cloudflare dashboard and follow the prompts to set up a new bucket for your digital products. From there, you can upload your files and configure the storage and delivery settings to meet your specific needs.
What is the cost of using R2?

R2 is free to use, with no fixed costs or fees. However, you will need to pay for storage and delivery costs, which are based on the amount of data you store and the number of requests you receive. Cloudflare also offers a tiered pricing model, which means that you only pay for the services you use.
Can I use R2 with other platforms like Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can use R2 with other platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. However, keep in mind that R2 is designed to be a drop-in replacement for traditional storage solutions, so you may not need to use these platforms at all. With R2, you can deliver your digital products directly to your customers, without the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal.
How do I ensure that my digital products are delivered quickly and efficiently?

To ensure that your digital products are delivered quickly and efficiently, you'll need to configure the storage and delivery settings on R2 to meet your specific needs. This may involve setting up caching, using CDNs, and configuring the payment settings to meet your specific requirements. With the Complete Builder Kit, you can get instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, making it easy to deploy and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Can I use R2 to store and deliver large files?

Yes, R2 is designed to handle large files and can store and deliver files of up to 5 GB in size. If you need to store or deliver files larger than this, you may need to use a different solution. However, R2 is a great option for storing and delivering most digital products, including ebooks, courses, and software.
How do I set up payment processing with R2 and NOWPayments?

To set up payment processing with R2 and NOWPayments, you'll need to integrate R2 with NOWPayments using Cloudflare Workers. From there, you can configure the payment settings to meet your specific needs and test the entire system to ensure that it's working correctly.
